169a124dc2.q: What is the key lesson Mike Stohler teaches about starting a real estate business without proper knowledge?

Mike warns against jumping into real estate after watching HGTV episodes or YouTube videos expecting to become a millionaire in 30 days—his early failures came from lack of knowledge, not from real estate itself.
